It uses a modified version of the [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode as its wave structure. Triumphing on this map rewards the player with {{Gem|110}}, {{Exp|330}}, {{TimeScaleTicket|2}} and two [[High Grade Crate]]s. Like with other challenges, rewards can only be gotten once a week. ==Changes== The main change in this challenge is enemies spawning twice as much, with some exceptions, and the wave structure being altered, making it harder. Unlike the [[All Paths]] modifier, bosses do spawn on both sides, meaning two [[Fallen King]]s spawn on this map. ===Enemies=== All enemy replacements from [[Enemies Beta]] are applied here, with the exception of the [[Dark Necromancer]] and [[Summoner Boss]] if the selected map does not have [[Enemies Beta]]. A few regular enemies also have their health values, which for most of them is changed to match their previous [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode health values. *[[Abnormal]] - 6 health ({{Color|No|-2}}) *[[Quick]] - 4 health ({{Color|No|-6}}) *[[Heavy]] - 16 health ({{Color|No|-44}}) *[[Breaker2]] - 50 health ({{Color|No|-30}}) *[[Fallen]] - 180 health ({{Color|No|-45}}) *[[Necromancer King]] - 14,000 health ({{Color|No|-61,000}}) *[[Cursed Skeleton]] - 500 ({{Color|No|-750}}) *[[Fallen Hero]] - 5,000 health ({{Color|Yes|+2,000}}) *[[Fallen Guardian]] - 14,000 health ({{Color|No|-18,000}}) *[[Fallen King]] - 75,000 health ({{Color|No|-125,000}}) ===Wave Structure=== '''Bolded ''' names indicate an enemy type's debut. If the [[All Paths]] modifier is present on the map, all enemies will be duplicated for each path except the [[Fallen King]].

===Cash=== Starting cash in this challenge is increased by {{Money|200}}, making it {{Money|700}} ({{Money|800}} if in the Paradoxum Games group). Additionally, the wave bonus is also decreased. For solo and duo, they calculated as: :{{Money|125}} + ({{Money|25}} × Waves Completed - 1) Depending on player count, the wave bonus is reduced using multipliers. These multipliers are: {| class="wikitable align-center" style="width:50%; margin:1em auto" !Players !Reduction per Player !Total Reduction |- |Solo |0% |0% |- |Duo |15% |30% |- |Trio |13% |39% |} The wave clear bonus appears when every enemy from that wave was killed. It is 35% of the wave bonus in solo, while for duo and trio it is 20%. ==Strategy== *Due to the large amount of enemies, you generally gain a larger amount of cash, enabling you to afford more DPS towers compared to normal games. *Area of effect towers are recommended because large groups of enemies spawn in this challenge. **Towers like the [[Golden Pyromancer]], [[Pyromancer]] and [[Electroshocker]] are very useful early on. **The [[Mortar]] and [[Pursuit]] are especially useful for this challenge, as they have high range and cannot get stunned. *Single target DPS options like the [[Accelerator]], [[Golden Minigunner]] and [[Ranger]] are still valuable, as enemies such as the [[Warden]] have a lot of health. **As the enemy count is doubled, the [[Cowboy]] and the [[Golden Cowboy]] can generate much more income in this challenge. *Towers with hidden detection should be placed down early on, as early [[Nimble]] [[Shadows]] may result in an early defeat. *A balance between AOE towers and single target towers can prevent Breakers from overwhelming you. *[[Slime (Attribute)|Slime]] [[Glitch]]es can turn into hordes of enemies that can easily overwhelm your defenses. **Stalling towers like the [[Electroshocker]] or [[Cryomancer]] are useful, as they grant you more time to kill these enemies. ==Challenge History== *'''7 July 2024 – 14 July 2024''' **Map:
